living.title: 客厅 · 紫砚留白
living.copy: 墨紫矿物墙面包裹公共空间，烟灰石地面与低矮织物沙发衔接，窗光让深色纹理显影。
living.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: architectural interior photograph for apartment tour, native 1536x1024 landscape. Redesign as 紫砚隐居: tactile contemporary mineral retreat. Structural reference only: preserve compact apartment proportions, original straight walls and window/door openings and camera, completely replace decoration. Architecture BLACKENED INK-PURPLE #211F29 plaster and integrated cabinetry, purple undertone clearly visible in reflected daylight across LARGE WALL PLANES, not accent furniture. Chocolate ashwood #30251F, medium smoky taupe #655B54, graphite brown stone. Ceiling medium warm grey, NO white walls or cream ceiling. Public floor large dark smoke pietra-gray/slate slabs #494444 with narrow joints, no white marble. Soft natural window daylight and restrained warm task lighting reveal tactile materials, realistic exposure, no neon, no flat black underexposure, no hotel art, no botanical prints, no text or watermarks. Contemporary restrained sculptural furniture and minimal one-piece ceramics. ROOM LIVING: keep original reference camera looking from balcony toward dining, sofa at right, TV at left, central dining at far wall. Remove all traditional walnut paneling, framed pictures, tray ceiling and decorative glass motifs. Flat medium warm-grey ceiling. Right large sofa wall and dining back wall are deeply saturated blackened ink-purple mineral plaster, visible near-black plum in daylight. New low charcoal-taupe woven modular sofa on right with brown cushions, black-purple woven rug, sculptural rounded graphite brown stone coffee table, dark chocolate floating TV joinery on left with ink-purple backdrop. Slim bronze floorlight, hidden integrated ink-purple cabinets, central dining dark stone table with four dark brown saddle chairs. An expensive quiet residential photograph with daylight from camera side revealing rich PURPLE BLACK architectural texture. Native exact 1536x1024.
